attempts.summary: Added a persistent 520 MiB disk-backed swap file on node1. It provides 545,255,424 usable bytes at priority 100, preferred over the existing swap partition at priority -2. A full reboot confirmed automatic activation. RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, SSH, and enforcing SELinux were preserved. The pre-existing ip_set driver warning remains non-fatal.
